title: Generative AI and digital neocolonialism in global education: Towards an equitable framework

live_model.evidence: "GenAI systems were employed, ChatGPT-4 (turbo, advanced mode) developed by OpenAI...The premium mode of ChatGPT provided access to GPT-4 Turbo, an OpenAI's premium large-language-model variant"; "GPT-4 cost over $20.00 per month".

prompt.note: Described only as "zero-shot prompt testing" for lesson-planning tasks; example interactions are given as authors' screenshots, not quoted prompt text.

claim.metric: none (qualitative comparison of ChatGPT vs Gemini lesson-planning outputs; no accuracy/score reported)

data.source: Authors' own screenshots of ChatGPT/Gemini sessions for lesson-planning scenarios; no dataset released

notes: "Premium mode of ChatGPT" and its $20/month cost confirm this is the consumer ChatGPT Plus website, not the API. This is a qualitative/critical-pedagogy paper (digital neocolonialism framing); it contains no quantitative benchmark of the model.
